root_cause_criterion.obligation: Immediately before the `strcpy` block executes, the returned lookup string length must be at most 63 characters so the documented caller-provided output buffer contract remains satisfied.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable `idn2_to_ascii_4i` path reaches the copy block with only `rc == IDN2_OK` and `output != NULL`; it never enforces the documented 63-character output bound on `output_u8` before `strcpy`. The fixed program computes the same length first and returns `IDN2_TOO_BIG_DOMAIN` when it exceeds 63.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, `strcpy` consumes the same `output_u8` heap string selected at the root guard site, so the unchecked overlong lookup name reaches the copy unchanged on the crashing call.

edges.relation: The same `output_u8` pointer observed at the missing-guard site is passed unchanged as the source argument to the subsequent `strcpy` sink.
